name: browser
description: A real web browser (WebKitGTK) running on SwirlOS's Linux layer.
author: WebKit, Mesa, GTK and friends (Ubuntu 24.04 builds); SwirlOS bridge by Swirl
title: Web Browser
long: The WebKitGTK MiniBrowser from Ubuntu 24.04 running on the SwirlOS Linux layer, shown in a normal SwirlOS window.\nHTTP and HTTPS with certificate checking, modern HTML/CSS/JavaScript. Software rendering (Mesa llvmpipe), so it is slower than a desktop browser.\nBig download (about 400 MB) and needs the r84 kernel. Open it from the start menu (Web Browser).
